subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should this PR become the canonical Feishu invalid-token recovery branch after stronger target-code proof, or should maintainers choose a sibling implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287?
rationale: Multiple open branches implement the same auth/message-delivery behavior, and the all-cache invalidation scope needs owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Use this branch after proof
options.body: Require redacted runtime proof for 99991663/99991664 recovery, then keep this branch as canonical if the cache invalidation scope is acceptable.

options.title: Choose a sibling branch
options.body: Select another open Feishu invalid-token PR if its smaller diff or account-scoped refresh is preferred, then close this PR as superseded after preserving useful context.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Hold all candidate branches if Feishu owners want a different cache ownership design before retry behavior lands.

recommendation.title: Use this branch after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted runtime proof for 99991663/99991664 recovery, then keep this branch as canonical if the cache invalidation scope is acceptable.
